system.name: PartIR
system.one_liner: a hardware- and runtime-agnostic system that composes SPMD partitioning strategies to shard neural network training across devices

content.subject: how batch parallelism's full AllReduce of gradients contrasts with Z3/FSDP's sharded AllGather of parameters and ReduceScatter of gradients

elements.role: one of two device containers running a replica/shard of the training step

elements.role: the other device container, mirrors Device 1's structure

elements.role: forward pass over the device's batch shard

elements.name: update
elements.role: applies the (reduced/scattered) gradient to produce new parameters

elements.name: params
elements.role: parameter tensor fed into the forward pass, replicated in batch parallelism or sharded in FSDP

elements.name: batch[0]
elements.role: input batch shard routed to Device 1

elements.name: AllReduce
elements.role: collective that sums gradients across devices in batch parallelism

elements.name: AllGather
elements.role: collective that gathers the full parameter shard just before it is used in FSDP

elements.name: ReduceScatter
elements.role: collective that reduces and re-shards gradients across devices in FSDP

elements.name: new params
elements.role: updated parameter (or parameter shard) produced by the update step

panels.label: top: batch parallelism
panels.differs: parameters and optimizer state are fully replicated on each device; only gradients are AllReduced before the update

panels.label: bottom: Z3/FSDP
panels.differs: parameters are sharded and AllGathered just before use (highlighted thick blue bars), and gradients are ReduceScattered instead of AllReduced, so each device only ever holds a shard

content.key_idea: Contrasting batch parallelism's full-parameter AllReduce of gradients with Z3/FSDP's sharded design, which AllGathers parameters just-in-time and ReduceScatters gradients, trading extra communication for lower peak memory.
content.reading_order: top panel first, left to right within each Device box (params/batch into fwd, into bwd, into the shared collective, into update); then the bottom panel repeats the same layout with the added AllGather bars

summary: This figure from PartIR's background section contrasts two SPMD parallelization strategies. The top panel shows batch parallelism: each device (Device 1, Device 2) holds a full parameter replica, runs a forward (fwd) and backward (bwd) pass on its batch shard, and the resulting gradients are AllReduced across devices before a shared update step produces new parameters. The bottom panel shows Z3/FSDP: parameters are instead sharded per device, so before each forward pass the needed shard is AllGathered from the other device (highlighted with thick blue bars), and after the backward pass gradients are ReduceScattered rather than AllReduced, yielding a distinct new parameter shard per device. Stacking the two structurally identical device-pair diagrams lets the reader see exactly which stage changes: FSDP inserts an AllGather before the forward pass and swaps AllReduce for ReduceScatter, trading extra communication for the lower peak memory of never materializing full parameters or gradients on one device.
summary_zh: 该图对比PartIR背景部分的两种SPMD并行策略：上方批并行在反向传播后对梯度做AllReduce；下方Z3/FSDP将参数分片，使用前先AllGather（蓝色粗条高亮），梯度改为ReduceScatter，从而降低峰值显存。
notes: content.base corrected from the prior label 'architecture' (not a valid v3 base value) to 'component', since the figure is drawn as boxes (fwd/bwd/update) inside Device containers connected by data arrows.
